title: PublicMeetingOccurrencesResponse
description: E6-01 (#3584) response of GET /public/api/meetings/:id/occurrences, gated as GET /public/api/meetings/:id is (a 403 when the caller passes no gate, or when the live series cannot be loaded). Mirrors PublicMeetingOccurrencesResponse (packages/shared/src/interfaces/meeting.interface.ts). Both projections are built field by field, never passed through from ITX, so additionalProperties is false: no description, password, join details or registrant identities.

past.description: Past occurrences from v1_past_meeting records, ascending by scheduled start time. Timestamps only.

future.description: Current and future occurrences of the live series; empty when the series no longer exists.

cancelled_occurrences.description: Cancelled occurrence IDs of the live series, as 10-digit Unix-second keys.

meeting_and_occurrence_id.description: Composite past-meeting id: the numeric meeting id and the occurrence's 13-digit millisecond start.

occurrence_id.description: The canonical occurrence id, a Unix-second start (10 digits).

status.description: available | cancel, as ITX reports it.

title.description: The occurrence's title, sent to every caller who passes the gate.

registrant_count.description: Registrants for this occurrence. Present only for a caller the gate let in as a registrant or organizer. Absent for anyone let in by a public meeting's open gate or by the passcode, a signed-in registrant or organizer included: both gates skip the identity lookups.
